af_spec.seed_note: The user said any seed; 1337 is retained only as a deterministic reproducible value and has no identity meaning.

capability_limits.face_identity: The current af_spec and image analyser do not reconstruct or preserve the Love.jpg face.
capability_limits.eyes: No af_spec eye-colour field or identity-conditioned eye reconstruction exists; the canonical red-eye treatment needs a new material/character parameter or a separate approved rendering effect.
capability_limits.fangs: The engine has generic dental-arch geometry but no dedicated canine/fang geometry and no ARKit fang channel. Fangs require custom geometry and, if retractable, custom non-ARKit morph targets.
capability_limits.blendshapes: The current 52 channels are the standard ARKit-compatible facial set; none represents fangs.
capability_limits.wardrobe: OUTFIT_NONE and FOOTWEAR_NONE describe the fitting base only. A final compliant full-avatar export still requires an explicitly selected, fully modelled/textured outfit and footwear.
